features.detail: Agent named Senna runs a 5-stage loop shown on the homepage: Learn your brand -> Research the market -> Create -> Launch -> Learn, then 'Lap again'. Results from Learn feed the next Create batch.
features.notable: One named agent owns the whole pipeline; the loop framing ('Lap again') makes iteration the default.

features.detail: Input: one website URL. Output: brand profile (product, audience, tone). Homepage shows derived stats such as 'ads scanned', 'days, top ad', 'discount-led', 'no captions', 'organic posts'.
features.notable: No brief needed; derived observations (e.g. 'discount-led', 'no captions') are shown back to the user as proof the agent understood the brand.

features.detail: Studies competitors and customers. Shows audience personas (examples: Biohacker, Busy Professional, Fitness Lover), 'reviews read' and the rival's longest-running top ad ('day top rival ad').
features.notable: Persona chips plus a 'top rival ad' card make research tangible before any content is made.

features.detail: Formats named on the homepage: Chalkboard, Claymation, Baby podcast, Netflix doc, Competitor remix (example 'AG1 remix'), Car yapper, Breaking news, Meme, AI podcast, Papermation, Static, Trolley remix, Pills, Text on body, Winner variation.
features.notable: Formats are named after recognisable viral genres, not technical types, so users pick by vibe.

features.detail: Homepage shows a competitor static ad (example AG1) remixed into the user's brand version. Mechanics (which elements are kept vs swapped) are not described publicly (unverified).
features.notable: Competitor ad -> your brand version is shown as a first-class format, not a hidden tool.

features.detail: Library of 25,000+ trending videos tagged by niche and performance. Flow: Paste your URL -> 'Pick trends to remix' (browse by niche and analytics) -> 'Generate and swipe' -> 'Schedule to TikTok'. Fastlane analyses structure, pacing, hook style and visual rhythm, then 'rebuilds the format around your product instead of copying the video'.
features.notable: Explicitly rebuilds the structure rather than reposting, which avoids takedowns and puts the product in.

features.detail: From one URL Fastlane generates a batch across four formats: 'AI UGC videos' (talking creator), 'Slideshows' (photo carousel), 'Hook + demo videos' (text hook then product in use) and 'Memes'.
features.limits_or_cost: Free plan: no card; paid from $29/mo (per tool pages)
features.notable: One input fans out into several proven formats at once.

features.detail: Generated content is reviewed in 'Blitz mode' (also called 'Tinder mode'): swipe to approve or reject each video; 'Nothing publishes without your approval'. Included on the Free plan.
features.notable: Swipe review is the approval gate; fast for batches and fits a compliance step for advisers.

features.detail: 4 steps: 'Paste your website URL' -> 'Cast your AI influencer' (browse characters by look, age, vibe; 'the same face fronts every video') -> 'Generate a batch of videos' (hooks + scripts, talking-head UGC) -> 'Schedule and publish natively'.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter 25 characters, Growth 500+, library 1,000+ (pages conflict); stock faces only, not your own face (Kompozy)
features.notable: Consistent recurring face per brand builds recognition across posts.

features.detail: Library of 2,000+ real human UGC clips usable in generated videos alongside AI characters.
features.notable: Mixes real human clips with AI so output is not 100% synthetic.

features.detail: Input URL -> each angle becomes a slideshow: hook slide, one idea per middle slide, closing product slide. Output in batches with a caption per platform and closing CTA (save on IG, follow on TikTok). Published natively as TikTok photo mode (played to a sound) and as an Instagram carousel from the same slides.
features.limits_or_cost: Template names, slide counts and image sources not published
features.notable: Same slides go to TikTok photo mode and IG carousel with platform-specific CTAs.

features.detail: Input URL -> memes about the product generated on formats pulled from the 25,000+ trending library -> Blitz approve -> schedule. Analytics show which memes drove profile visits, signups and sales.

Free browser tool: 5 fields (Product, Audience, Pain, Outcome, Timeframe) -> '30 hook structures filled with your words', runs locally, Copy per line. 11 hook types: Story, Contrarian, Curiosity, Question, Number, Direct, Mistake, Result, Challenge, Secret, Reaction. In-app every hook becomes a hook + demo video, AI UGC clip, slideshow opener or meme; per-hook attribution of signups and sales.
features.notable: Hooks are tested as real posts, not left as a list; a no-AI free tool doubles as an SEO lead magnet.

features.detail: One calendar for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn; schedule weeks ahead; same slot on every platform or staggered; 'Automations can fill an entire content calendar in one click'. UI labels: 'Connect your accounts', 'Fill the calendar', 'Set the times', 'Read the results'.
features.notable: One-click calendar fill from automations.

features.detail: Organic: native publish to TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn. Paid: Meta campaigns through the user's own Ads Manager; homepage status example 'Meta 30 ads live $5k/day'.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter: 1 social account (homepage) or TikTok/IG/YT/LinkedIn (/pricing); Growth+ unlimited socials
features.notable: Organic and paid in one calendar.

features.detail: Reads thumbstop rate, ROAS, hold rate and CPA against account averages, saves winners to memory and auto-creates variations ('Winner found. 6 variations made.').
features.notable: Winners automatically spawn variations: the remix loop closes on the user's own best posts.

features.detail: Unified analytics attribute signups and sales to each scheduled post, hook or meme, alongside engagement and the user's website analytics.
features.notable: Ties content to business outcomes, not just views.

features.detail: Real US and EU TikTok and Instagram accounts created and warmed by humans in your niche, run inside Fastlane.
features.limits_or_cost: $100/mo per account + $1.50 per post upload; needs active subscription
features.notable: Raises platform-terms questions (Kompozy).

features.detail: Credits are the only meter: a static costs 5 credits, a video 60 (homepage). Plans also cap campaigns (1/5/20), social accounts (1/10/500) and workspaces (-/3/10).
features.limits_or_cost: Homepage vs /pricing tables disagree on prices and credits
features.notable: Simple 2-number cost model (static vs video) is easy to explain.

features.detail: Workspaces per plan: Starter 1, Growth 3, Pro 10 (/pricing); campaigns per plan 1/5/20 (homepage).
Developer docs at developers.usefastlane.ai with an API and an MCP section. Endpoint and tool names are not readable without JS (unverified).

Public /models page lists 12 generation models: video (Vidu Q4, Gemini Omni, Sora 2 (discontinued), Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Kling 4.0, Wan 2.6, Grok Imagine, Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3) and image (GPT Image 2.5, Seedream 5.0).
Influencer page notes platform and regional AI-labeling rules vary and that Fastlane helps with labeling at publish time.
Free tools: engagement rate calculators (TikTok, Instagram), TikTok money calculator, TikTok profile template mockup, hook generator; each funnels to 'Try it free'.
features.notable: Free tools act as top-of-funnel onboarding.

features.detail: Done-for-you managed service offered through a 'Talk to us' form.

Channels page modes: Suggested (similar to watchlist, 'More like this'), Describe (text description + Platform + Account size Nano..Mega), Search (handle/name, Exact vs Approximate matches), Add URL (paste many profile URLs, 'Parse', 'Add all', 'Failed to Parse').
features.limits_or_cost: New channels count toward a monthly allowance (Pro 100, Visionary 150, Titan 250); Starter cannot add new channels
features.notable: Describe-your-niche search finds competitors without knowing handles.

features.detail: Track channels on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts in one watchlist dashboard; on-demand refresh interval by plan.

Outlier score = video views vs the channel's median views over the 90 days before it was posted ('3x means three times the usual views'). Filters: Saved Filters, Channels, Keywords, Outlier score min/max, Views, Engagement % ((Likes+Comments)/Views), Posted in last N days/weeks/months/years, Platform. Sort: Saved recently, Newest (default), Oldest, Outlier score, Views, Engagement rate.
features.notable: Normalising by the creator's own median makes small accounts' hits visible; this is the core of finding remixable content.

features.detail: 'Browsing mode' toggles between your watchlist and 'Global Sandcastles' (database of millions of validated outliers). Global hides saved filters and channel filters.

Hover a video -> 'Analyze' (1 credit) -> idea lands in the Ideas Inbox, video gets a green 'Analyzed' label. 'Bulk Analyze' queues up to 100 videos, skipping already analyzed ones. 'Add video URL' analyzes any pasted video.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per video; Bulk Analyze Pro+
features.notable: Analysis is a paid unit, browsing is free.

features.detail: Each idea shows: Your Notes, Content Positioning (distinct angle), Storytelling Format + 'Why it Works', Contrast Mechanism (common belief vs contrarian reality), Hook Alignment, and 'How to Personalize this Video for Your Content Niche' (3 adaptation ideas, needs Persona).
features.notable: Structured teardown fields are exactly what a remix engine needs as input.

features.detail: Ideas Inbox actions: Shortlist, Discard, Go to Analysis, Turn into script. Keyboard: S, D, A, C, E, arrows. 'Discard all' has no confirmation and no undo. Export Inbox/Shortlist/All. Automation-created ideas carry a purple lightning icon.
features.notable: Inbox-zero triage of viral ideas.

features.detail: Scripts -> 'New Script': (1) Script from scratch (topic -> Continue), (2) Remix an existing idea (Ideas -> 'Create script'; topic, substance and writing style carried over), (3) 'Fix an existing script' (paste draft + requested changes).
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per new script incl. fix; edits free

features.detail: Stages: Topic -> Research (editable or deletable, can use your own research) -> Hook (view example hooks, keep/edit/generate, select one) -> Script (changes highlighted yellow; choose 'Rewrite from scratch' or 'Edit script').
features.notable: Staged flow with a hook-pick step before the body is written; diff highlighting shows what the AI changed.

features.detail: Fields autosave: Content description (5,000 chars, niche), Context (5,000 chars, business/expertise), Writing style (3,000 chars, paste a sample script only, no instructions). Shapes scripts, research and suggested channels.
features.notable: Voice is learned from a pasted sample, not adjectives.

features.detail: Generate dozens of hooks in seconds from hook templates that have millions of views; MCP exposes working hook patterns as reusable templates.

Reports tab: 'Create report' -> type 'Content Strategy Audit' -> pick channels -> optional schedule (Just once / Every day / 7 / 30 days), analysis budget (min 15 videos), which videos (Most recent / Most views / Highest engagement / Biggest outliers), lookback, 'Exclude brand deals' (<2% engagement). Export JSON, Email, 'Continue with MCP'.
features.limits_or_cost: Base report cost + 1 credit per newly analyzed video; Pro+
features.notable: Recurring competitor audits delivered by email.

features.detail: Verifying a social account auto-creates '@handle - Monthly Content Strategy Audit' (every 30 days, budget 15, starts paused). Personal Analytics Dashboard shows the latest audit.
Download the transcript of any video; organise winning ideas into Projects and Collections.
Server https://mcp.sandcastles.ai/ for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok, Meta Muse, Hermes. Capability areas: Formats, Hooks, Competitors, Ideas, Topics, Breakdowns, Discovery, Watchlist, Scripts.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro+; questions free, analysing a new video 1 credit; API on Titan only

features.detail: Plan credits 10/100/250/1,500 reset monthly (annual: every 30 days), no rollover. Boost credits bought in Settings > Subscription never expire and are spent after plan credits.
Workspaces 1/3/5/20 by plan, each with its own Persona and watchlist; guest access on Titan for agencies.

Tools > Inspiration -> click 'Remix' under a post -> Blotato generates an adapted version 'keeping the essence intact' -> add your own story/POV -> refine with Chat. Fallback: New Post, add the example as Text context, describe the adaptation.
features.notable: One-click remix of a text post plus an explicit prompt to add personal experience.

features.detail: Inspiration section: Tutorial, Search Topics, Shuffle, Apply Filters, Find Influencers, Request Topics. Creator plan adds an 'unlimited database of viral posts'.

Feed a YouTube link, TikTok, X post, article, PDF, audio file, raw text or a live Perplexity research query as Context; Blotato returns publish-ready content. YouTube extraction needs English captions.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited sources and AI writing on all plans
features.notable: Any URL becomes source material for a remix.

features.detail: Older Remix screen: platform checkboxes choose draft formats (not accounts), up to 5 posts per generation, 'Generate Post'. AI Agent: 'Write posts about...' box, Chat revisions, 'New draft'.

Templates: Product Scene Placement, Image Slideshow with Text Overlays, Instagram Carousel Slideshow, Quote Card (Monocolor / Paper Background and Highlight), Tweet Card (Minimal / Photo-Video Background), Tutorial Carousel (Minimalist Flat / Monocolor), Image Slideshow with Prominent Text, When X then Y Text Slideshow, Video of Images and Text, Combine Clips and Apply Basic Edits, Single Centered Text Quote.

Art-style infographic templates: TV Wall, Newspaper, Breaking News, Movie Theater, Graffiti Mural, Bus Ad, Billboard, Classroom Chalkboard, Whiteboard, Chalkboard, Trail Marker, Constellation, Manga Panel, T-Shirt, Futuristic Flyer, Book Page, Steampunk, Top Secret, Egyptian Hieroglyph, Cave Painting.
features.notable: Scene-based infographics (text placed on a billboard, newspaper, chalkboard) are cheap, distinctive formats.

features.feature: AI avatar and selfie video templates
features.detail: Templates 'AI Avatar with AI Generated B-roll', 'AI Selfie Talking Video with Consistent Character' and 'AI Video with AI Voice'; also posts video made in HeyGen, Veo or Sora.

Settings > My Brand: Language, Brand name, Website; 'What products or services do you offer?', 'Describe your ideal customers', 'Where are your customers located?'; 'What do you post about?'; Brand Visuals (images up to 10MB) and Brand Documents (PDF/decks up to 25MB). Multiple brands with a Primary. 'Use brand kit' toggle on visual generation, off by default.
features.notable: Brand selector on the AI Agent sidebar switches brand context per draft.

features.detail: Post now, at a timestamp, or 'Next free slot time'; recurring weekly slots per platform and per account; calendar with timezone.
features.notable: Slot-based queue so agents and humans just say 'next slot'.

features.detail: X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest via one create_post call; First Comment support.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter 20 accounts, Creator 40; up to 900 TikTok posts/mo on Starter

features.detail: Read comment and conversation lists, open threads, post replies and send DMs from the app or API.
Keyword triggers on comments or DMs, per post or account-wide, with triggered/completed/failed analytics.
features.notable: Comment-keyword to DM is a lead capture path.

features.detail: Top posts by views, likes or comments; per-post metrics with snapshot history; DM automation stats.
Hosted MCP (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Replit), REST at backend.blotato.com/v2 (POST /v2/posts with accountId, content, target, scheduledTime), official n8n and Make nodes.
Published Claude skills: content-coach, brand-brief, post-writer, post-grader, post-scheduler, repurpose, viral-hooks, generate.
features.notable: Ships its workflow as agent skills so external agents run it.

features.detail: Credits cover AI images/video; writing unlimited; ElevenLabs voiceovers use no credits. Image-to-video per clip: framepack 55, kling 210, luma 170, runway gen3 85, minimax 170, veo2 835, veo3 1,250, veo3/fast 400; Gemini Omni Flash 35 credits/s (720p), 50/s (1080p). Cost shown above 'Regenerate'; charged only on success.
features.limits_or_cost: Trial 60 credits; packs $6/1,000; credits roll over
features.notable: Charge only on successful generation.

features.detail: 58 languages, AI voices and captions, ElevenLabs voiceovers, multi-language video templates.

features.feature: AI actor library with written emotion
features.detail: 1,000+ AI actors; delivery controlled by writing it ('You have full emotion control. Just write how you want it', example 'Surprised'); Gestures feature for body language.
features.limits_or_cost: Talking actors 800 credits per minute per actor, rounded up; Gesture preset 240
features.notable: Emotion as free text instead of a dropdown.

features.feature: Clone yourself into a talking actor
features.detail: Record one continuous take of at least 2 min (2.5 min recommended), face fully visible, mouth never covered; send to Arcads; a custom model is trained on appearance and voice; then generate talking-head videos on demand.
features.limits_or_cost: PRO plan only; 1,600 credits per video
features.notable: Voice cloned from the same reference video, no separate step.

features.detail: Generate a face and 'make them hold your product, show your app, and wear your clothes'. Presets: Show Your App 200 credits, Unboxing POV 400, Product showcase 800, Fashion try-on 800, Camera movement 240.
features.notable: Preset per ad trope with a fixed price.

features.detail: Add competitors to a brand -> ads synced from Meta Ad Library, stored and analysed; sort by spend, impressions, running time, advertiser. Save proven ads as 'Winning ads' (broken into a reusable structure). Ask Mark to recreate a winning/reference ad or analyse a Meta campaign and clone its top performer. Optional: 'Replace Actor', translate.
features.limits_or_cost: Generations use credits; 'Misleading content is not allowed'
features.notable: Winning ads are decomposed into a reusable structure before cloning.

features.detail: Claude skills: spy-competitor-ads (find competitor ads in Meta Ad Library), clone-hook (adapt a reference video's hook to your brand), clone-static-ad (adapt a static ad for your product), viral-clone (recreate a reference video ad with a different product).
features.notable: Clone types split by format: hook, static, full video.

features.detail: Plain-language brief (example '20-second UGC-style ad for our protein bar, 9:16, US audience') -> Mark picks models/tools, generates, edits on a timeline, can publish Meta ads, researches TikTok/IG/X, finds real UGC creators, runs routines 'daily, weekly or every few hours'. Works in Slack.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans + trial; chat turns charged by tokens
features.notable: Scheduled routines turn the agent into a recurring producer.

features.detail: When a brand is added Mark reads the website, researches the brand and fills brand memory: overview, products, brand voice, target audience. Editable in the Brain panel. Custom Instructions up to 2,000 chars apply to every message; Presets set tone, default resolution and whether Mark asks before editing.

Generate several spoken hooks with the same actor and voice -> 'Stitch Videos' joins each hook to the main body -> 'Text Overlay' for headline hooks -> 'Replace Actor' keeps script, timing and scene -> optional translation with lip sync, workflow or Mark.
features.limits_or_cost: Stitch 0, Text Overlay 0, Replace Actor 500 (800 on credits page), captions 8 (80 on credits page)
features.notable: Keep the winning body, test only the first seconds.

features.detail: Nodes (inputs, models, tools) connected and run as a pipeline; example: one UGC script across 10 characters and 2 markets in one run; '20 x 8-second clips, 10 English, 10 Spanish'. Shared 'Open workflow' links.
